channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Vance says US, Iran have made “a lot of progress” towards deal
item.description: US Vice President JD Vance says Washington and Tehran have made “a lot of progress” towards ceasefire

item.title: Five killed in Lebanon as Israeli forces advance across key Litani River
item.description: Attacks come ahead of security talks between Lebanese and Israeli military delegations at the Pentagon.

item.title: Israel strikes building in Gaza’s Shati refugee camp
item.description: Israel strikes building in Gaza’s Shati refugee camp.

item.title: US-Iran 60-day proposal: What we know
item.description: US-Iran memorandum of understanding reportedly covers Strait of Hormuz, sanctions relief and enriched uranium limits.

item.title: 'Poison seller' who sold toxic chemicals online to people across world admits aiding suicides
item.description: Kenneth Law admitted charges relating to Canadian victims - but families say he should also be charged in the UK over 79 deaths in Britain.

item.title: US and Iran 'very close' to deal but 'not there yet', Vance says
item.description: US officials earlier told the BBC that the framework of a ceasefire extension deal had been agreed, pending the approval of Trump and Iran's leadership.

item.title: Netanyahu says he has directed IDF to increase control of Gaza to 70%
item.description: The expansion in control by Israel would contradict the terms of the ceasefire Israel and Hamas agreed to in October 2025.

item.title: Gaza City hospitals say several killed in strike, as Israel targets Hamas leaders
item.description: At least five children were reportedly killed in the strike, which appears to have targeted a Hamas commander.

item.title: Israel hits Lebanese capital in 'targeted strike'
item.description: Beirut had until now largely been spared even as both Israel and Hezbollah accused each other of breaking last month's ceasefire.

item.title: Learning from Ukraine war, Hezbollah is now using fibre-optic drones to hit Israel
item.description: Fibre-optic drones are now Hezbollah's primary weapon against Israel's soldiers and civilians.
